name: Airmeet
description: Airmeet is an event platform for webinars, virtual conferences, hybrid and in-person events, community experiences and audience networking. Organizers use it to manage event programming, registrations, sessions, speakers, engagement, production and analytics.
agentUseSummary: Connect a customer-owned Airmeet access/secret key pair and select the community's documented data region, then let agents list bounded Airmeet or session metadata without people, engagement or recording data.

credentialRequirements.name: AIRMEET_ACCESS_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Airmeet access key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Generate the key pair in the customer's Airmeet community Integrations tab.

credentialRequirements.name: AIRMEET_SECRET_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Airmeet secret key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Store the paired secret encrypted; Relay sends it only to the selected region's /auth endpoint.

credentialRequirements.name: AIRMEET_REGION
credentialRequirements.label: Airmeet data region
credentialRequirements.helpText: Select default, EU, or US to match the customer's community URL and pin the documented API origin.

capabilities.label: Read event and session metadata
capabilities.description: List bounded Airmeet and session summaries without people or engagement data.

allowed.label: List Airmeets
allowed.description: List at most twenty-five Airmeet event summaries from one page.

allowed.label: List event sessions
allowed.description: List at most twenty-five redacted session summaries for one exact Airmeet.

blocked.label: Block people data
blocked.description: Participants, attendees, speakers, hosts, polls, questions, booths, direct-access links, recordings, UTM data and engagement analytics are not exposed.

blocked.label: Block mutations
blocked.description: Airmeet, session, participant, booth and webhook writes are not exposed.

blocked.label: Block raw API
blocked.description: Arbitrary endpoints, datacenter origins, cursors, bulk operations and raw responses are not exposed.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded event and session metadata reads run directly; people, engagement, recordings, writes, bulk and raw access stay blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same selected read surface runs without Relay per-action approval; key ownership, region pinning, bounds, redaction and provider authority still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts two typed Airmeet metadata reads and exchanges encrypted customer keys only at the selected fixed regional origin.
Relay mounts two typed Airmeet metadata reads and exchanges encrypted customer keys only at the selected fixed regional origin.

providerSetup.blocker: A customer Airmeet community, eligible API access, a generated access/secret key pair and an explicit matching data region are required for live acceptance.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the separate provider-console task, generate the customer key pair under Integrations > API Access Key, select the region that matches the community URL, store both keys encrypted, validate /auth plus the two bounded reads, revoke the pair provider-side on disconnect, and confirm subsequent denial.

evidence.supports: Airmeet documents default, EU and US API origins, customer-generated access/secret keys, POST /auth, thirty-day access tokens, bounded GET /airmeets and exact-event GET /airmeet/{id}/info session data.
Airmeet documents TLS for client-server traffic and encryption at rest, supporting Relay's encrypted-secret and fixed-HTTPS-origin boundary.
Airmeet presents its product as an event platform for webinars, conferences and audience experiences.
